correctness.rationale: Reduction of either SL2 length-two ring to SL2(F_q) has elementary abelian congruence kernel of order q³. In Witt characteristic four, Cayley–Hamilton for A²=I, detA=1 gives tr(A)A=2I and mod 2 forces reduction A=I, so every involution lies in abelian kernel. In the split ring write (X,h) with X traceless; h²=1 implies h=1 or a nonidentity transvection belonging to a unique root group U_L. Fixed X for that U_L is the 2-plane kI+kN_L, giving E_L=K_L×U_L, |E_L|=q³, |K∩E_L|=q², |E_L∩E_M|=q and q+2 maximal elementary abelian groups/cliques. The commuting relation reduces two non-K involutions to the same line, so every clique lies in one E_L or in K. Counting yields split involution spectrum c_I: q elements of size q⁴+q³−q², q³−q of size 2q³−q², and q⁴−q² of size q³, and ordered pair total q⁷+2q⁶−q⁵−q⁴. Independent brute-force ring-matrix multiplication and graph maximal-clique enumeration confirmed BOTH q=2 and q=4 split/Witt cases and all centralizer strata; universal proof remains algebraic.

originality.rationale: Stasinski 2021 Theorem 5.3 already proves the equality of irreducible character-degree multiplicities for the two length-two rings, and Remark 6.3 already observes a nontrivial transvection has no Witt involutive lift. These facts cannot count as original. The new claim classifies all maximal elementary abelian subgroups (one in Witt, q+2 in split), their exact intersection pencil and the complete involution-commuting centralizer spectra, yielding a sharper representation-theoretic distinction. General 2-local subgroup literature may contain an equivalent classification, but no direct prior implication was identified in inspected sources.

No individual Frobenius–Schur indicator classification or higher matrix rank result is claimed.

value.rationale: This complete projective-line classification of 2-local clique geometry separates two natural finite group families whose entire complex character-degree multiplicity distributions are identical. It strengthens a known single no-lift distinction into exact maximal-subgroup structure, intersection sizes, induced graph centralizer census and a Frobenius–Schur indicator-weighted sum obstruction, a motivated invariant rather than an arbitrary special example.

limitations: Only q=2^f, dimension two and length-two split/Witt rings.
